gloss: mostly; nearly all; for the most part

definitions.gloss: mostly; nearly all; for the most part
definitions.explanation: Almost all of something, or almost completely; as a noun, the greater part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あらかた{終|お}わった。
⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あらかた⟦{食|た}べられていた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Most of the food had already been eaten.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あらかた⟦{片付|かたづ}いた→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I've mostly unpacked from the move, but I still have to sort out my books.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あらかた{終|お}わる / ⟦{片付|かたづ}く→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧ / ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧: to be mostly finished
- あらかた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: most people
- あらかた⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: much as expected

WRITING:
The kanji spelling {粗方|あらかた} exists but is rare; the word is usually written in kana.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧: almost all, almost; the everyday word
- {大体|だいたい}: roughly, on the whole; あらかた says that only a little is left
